purpose: Classify every public input the AFP presentation seam consumes, so that what the verifier actually binds is stated rather than inferred. A public input that is not bound to an authenticated comparand is a value the presenter chooses; this file says which those are. tests/python/test_public_input_classification.py re-derives the field set from the reference dataclasses and demonstrates every bound and derived claim by mutation, so a new public input cannot enter the seam unclassified and a classification cannot outlive the check that earns it.

classes.bound: Compared against a comparand the caller authenticated, or against a literal this specification fixes. A mutation is rejected.
classes.derived: Recomputed by the verifier from authenticated inputs and then compared, so a presenter cannot supply it. A mutation is rejected.
classes.free: Not constrained against any authenticated value. The presenter chooses it. Where a mutation is nonetheless rejected, it is a consequence of another field's binding, never of this field being checked.

flow_policy.note: evidence.flow is a holder-declared label required to equal the caller's authenticated expected_flow and is folded as purpose afp:trust-flow:<flow> into the v2 proof context. Policy selection additionally reads expected_flow rather than evidence.flow. The equality gate and transcript fold are separate: the first rejects a mismatched label before proof verification, while the second prevents a proof minted for one flow from being relabelled for another.
flow_policy.open_flow_rationale: Safeguard 1 (Predicate Pluralism, section 12.8) protects a verifier's freedom to choose predicates in a bilateral interaction between equals, so AFP fixes no catalog for a counterparty-facing flow; the caller's RequiredPredicatePolicy governs. The section 6.3 catalog is closed only for tenant-to-operator telemetry, where its closure is a tenant protection.

evidence_fields.comparand: expected_flow and the derived v2 proof-context purpose afp:trust-flow:<expected_flow>
evidence_fields.rationale: A holder-declared label required to equal the caller's authenticated flow; the authoritative flow is also transcript-bound as the namespaced context purpose.
The active profile must be accepted for the authenticated flow and is a member of the recomputed proof-context preimage.
Compared only against evidence.profile to police the downgrade rule. Both sides are holder-supplied, so this is self-consistency; no authenticated value fixes what was requested.
The KERI-authenticated envelope presenter.

The holder-declared value must equal the AFP responder and the subject independently returned from an issuer-authenticated claim or companion subject-binding proof; the ZKC adapter must reject rather than echo this evidence field.
The meaning-bearing public statement, matched against the caller's required-predicate policy. Must be non-empty: a presentation proving nothing is the boolean verified label section 5.9 rejects.

The exact live session X_<64 lowercase hex> digest. It is compared to the caller-authenticated value and rejected at construction if malformed or if its unsigned big-endian reduction modulo the BN254 scalar modulus is zero. The distinct field projection is used by ZKA session members; the presentation preimage retains this original X_ value.

Recomputed as the canonical nonzero BN254 reduction of the SHA-256/JCS v2 identity/session/profile/scope record plus the authoritative namespaced trust-flow purpose. The record contains the validated original X_ session digest, not its ZKA field projection; the resulting proof context is never accepted as given.
The APR signing key must resolve through this AID's current KEL.
The authenticated AFP verifier key.
Scoped: recomputed from the authenticated session policy hash and compared. Anonymous: must be absent. Linkable: not constrained on that path.
Consumed as an input to the scope derivation, never compared. The holder declares its own epoch; a mutation is detected only because scope_id is derived from it.
Scoped: re-derived and compared, so a verifier-supplied literal scope is rejected. Anonymous: the zero sentinel. Linkable: must be absent.
Scoped: only required to be non-zero, never derived or compared to an authenticated value, so the holder chooses it. Anonymous: the zero sentinel. Linkable: must be absent.
Linkable: only required to be non-zero. Anonymous and scoped: must be absent, because mixing handle families is a conformance failure.

evidence_fields.comparand: the literal ZKC proof version this specification fixes for the active profile
evidence_fields.rationale: Anonymous and scoped require zkc:proof:v2; linkable requires the frozen zkc:proof:v1.

evidence_fields.comparand: the zka:bundle:v1 literal for the ZKA carrier, or absence for afp:credential-envelope:v1
evidence_fields.rationale: The bundle kind must agree with carrier_kind: substantive ZKA carriage names zka:bundle:v1, while native credential-only carriage names no ZKA bundle. A native carrier cannot assert bundle acceptance or settlement.

evidence_fields.comparand: the verifier-selected carrier path and the exact allowed (carrier_kind, zka_bundle_kind) pairs: (zka:bundle:v1, zka:bundle:v1) or (afp:credential-envelope:v1, absent)
evidence_fields.rationale: The presentation seam rejects unknown discriminators and mismatched carrier/bundle pairs. Native receive additionally requires the native discriminator with no bundle after authenticating the actual signed, encrypted carrier; ZKA bundle acceptance independently requires its substantive proofs. A coherent label alone authenticates neither carriage nor a proof.

evidence_fields.comparand: the literal true, on the linkable profile
evidence_fields.rationale: Linkable v1 requires explicit, recorded holder consent. On the other profiles the field is not read.

evidence_fields.comparand: the holder-derived handle set this specification permits for the active profile
evidence_fields.rationale: The three holder-derived handles (holderCommitment, presentationPseudonym, scopeId) must be exactly those the active profile permits, and must equal the evidence values; mixing handle families is a conformance failure. Only those three keys are policed: any other key in the mapping is unconstrained, so a deployment placing further data here gains no checking from this seam.

evidence_fields.comparand: the holder-derived handle set this specification permits for the active profile; all credential-rebind declarations are unsupported and rejected
evidence_fields.rationale: The same three-handle rule as the receipt. This reference verifier has no real cryptographic rotation-rebind acceptance path, so every rebind declaration (kind, proof, nested credential-rebind record, or old/new handle fields) is rejected rather than treated as a meaningful proof. A deployment with an actual §4.6.2 ZKC rebind verifier must perform that verification outside this reference path.

predicate_fields.comparand: required_predicates.accepted_predicate_ids, required_predicate_ids, and the closed section 6.3 catalog on the telemetry flow
predicate_fields.rationale: What was proven, matched against what the flow requires and accepts.
Bound at construction so that an unsupported predicate version is detectable rather than a free label.

predicate_fields.comparand: required_predicates.accepted_instance_attestation_roots and the three literal section 6.3.1 root classes
predicate_fields.rationale: An unknown class is rejected. Only instance attestation v2 may carry one: section 6.3.1 freezes v1 semantically, so a v1 proof must not be reinterpreted as carrying a generic root class. The section 14.4 comparison keys on the predicate identifier rather than on whether a root is present, so a v2 attestation that names no root class is rejected rather than skipped.

The pair must exactly match one signed accepted pair. Resolving that authority's key state, delegation chain, and revocation from its KEL is a separate section 6.3.1 obligation, discharged at the introduction tier only when a root_authority_resolver is supplied.

Validated for canonical whole-second UTC shape and ordering at construction, but the presentation seam holds no authenticated window to compare it against. The introduction tier binds it: evaluate_credentialing requires it to equal the introduction request's explicit window.
Required to be present for instance attestation, but not compared at the presentation seam. The introduction tier binds it to the presenting tenant.

verified_statement_fields.rationale: The deployment verifier returns the exact proof-context public input authenticated by proof verification; AFP compares it to its canonical nonzero BN254 recomputation and the snapshotted evidence statement.

The deployment verifier derives this value from an issuer-authenticated AID claim or independently verified companion proof. AFP rejects an absent or differing result; the adapter must not copy the evidence label.

The deployment verifier returns the atomic public statements authenticated by proof verification; AFP compares their exact primitive wires to the evidence snapshot after independently applying the caller's policy.

undischarged_obligations.obligation: Resolve a root authority's current key state, delegation chain, revocation, and succession from its KEL before acceptance.
undischarged_obligations.discharged_by: afp_introduction.credentialing.evaluate_credentialing, through a caller-supplied root_authority_resolver. Absent one, a presentation carrying an attestation root is declined: section 6.3.1 requires a verifier that cannot resolve the chain to reject with instance_attestation_untrusted_authority, so not resolving is not a softer form of resolving.

undischarged_obligations.obligation: Recompute root_material_digest from resolved KEL state and reject a mismatch.
undischarged_obligations.discharged_by: Not represented at this seam: ProvenPredicate carries the meaning-bearing subset of the v2 public inputs, not the full fifteen-member statement.

undischarged_obligations.obligation: Bind the predicate identifier and version into the proof transcript.
undischarged_obligations.discharged_by: The ZKC circuit. AFP does not build the transcript; the ZkcVerifier callback returns a structured ZkcVerifiedPublicStatement only when the circuit's verified proof context and predicate set equal the evidence exactly, and returns None on rejection.

undischarged_obligations.obligation: Authenticate the credential-subject AID rather than trust a presenter label.
undischarged_obligations.discharged_by: ZkcVerifiedPublicStatement.credential_subject_aid, produced only from an issuer-authenticated AID claim or independently verified companion subject-binding proof and compared to both expected_responder_aid and evidence.credential_subject_aid. Generic ZKC KYC and jurisdiction profiles do not establish an AID by themselves, so an adapter using either alone must reject.
